case_number: 2024 INSC 242; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 3835 – 3836 OF 2024 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (CIVIL) NOS. 5741 – 5742 OF 2024)
summary: Enforcement of foreign arbitral award challenged over alleged arbitrator bias; standard: IBA Guidelines on conflict of interest under Section 48(2)(b); Presiding Arbitrator's role in Wing Tai deemed immaterial; arbitral award valid despite objection; NN Global stamping doctrine overruled; contempt for non-compliance with deposit order; enforcement upheld; appeals dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court order enforcing foreign award confirmed; attachment order upheld; contempt proceedings validated.
